text:
julia: Heads-up — ACME asked for per-tenant response-priority routing (they want priority queues so premium customers get lower latency). They called it a showstopper for their pilot. Thoughts?

mike: that's basically per-tenant queueing + weighted scheduling. doable but non-trivial. estimated ~3 sprint effort to do properly with infra changes.

tess: can we short-term ship a shim? route-priority flag that pins to a faster model pool for now. lower engineering cost, but will need billing/quotas work.

ali: ACME says timeline is end of quarter. they'd pay for dedicated capacity if we can promise $-per-month guarantee. big sale if we move fast :eyes: 

sam: risk: per-tenant queues increase tail latency complexity. we should measure KV cache hit regressions. recommend an eval with synthetic tenant traffic (50/1 skew) before any rollout.

julia: agree on eval. two options on table:
- ship parity (queues) to match competitor exactly — speeds adoption but high cost + ops
- ship strategic differentiator: per-route SLOs + smart fallback (model variant + cached responses) — better long-term but takes longer

mike: for a minimal parity shim here's a config we could accept:
```
route: acme
priority: premium
pool: dedicated-hot
max_tokens_per_minute: 20000
```
This keeps changes localized to routing layer.

tess: also need SDK headers + metrics (x-tenant-priority) so customers can opt in. small SE work.

ali: if we present a canary plan + SLA delta (90->95 p50/p95) ACME might accept staging for pilot. need commercial ok.

ops-bot: deploy-started: ci/route-priority-shim build #482 passed. link: https://ci.redwood/482

julia: proposed decision: ship shim + pilot with ACME, telemetry gated. in parallel, start spec for per-route SLOs as strategic next-quarter work. who owns pilot?

tess: i can lead pilot onboarding and SDK changes.

mike: eng will scope the shim and run evals. i'll put a spike ticket.

sam: i'll run the synthetic skew traffic and produce a short report (latency, cache hit, cost diff).

ali: i'll draft the commercial proposal and be ready to negotiate capacity commitment.

julia: ok let's sync tomorrow 10am. action items: mike spike, sam eval, tess SDK + pilot plan, ali commercial draft. :thumbsup:
